full_judgment: 2. The facts leading to the Rule, in brief, are, that the petitioner Dr. Mohammad Abdul Baten lodged information with Mirpur Police Station alleging, inter alia, that he purchased 5 kathas of land in plot No. 284 of khatian No. 1057 of mouza Senpara Parbata under Police Station Mirpur, Dhaka from one Noor Mohammad by registered Deed No. 2570 dated 15.2.75 and he was in possession of the said land cultivating the same through bargadars. Some days after when the informant went to the land he saw some unauthorised sheds over the disputed land and on query he came to know that one Idris Ali Dewan forcibly constructed the said huts and accordingly a Criminal Case bearing Mirpur PS Case No. 37 dated 24.10.77 (GR Case No. 5949 of 1977) under section 447 of the Penal Code was started against the accused opposite party No. 2.
